label: Services
title: How we can work
lead: Two ways in — the full map if you’re just starting, a sharp outside read if you already know the terrain.

items.title: From idea to ship
items.text: For first-timers: lean canvas, customer interviews, pitches for clients and investors, then build, team, and support — the full arc from idea to something that runs.

items.title: Brainstorm
items.text: For people who already know the game. A working session with clean eyes on what you’ve got — scars from CEO and CBDO roles across SaaS, deeptech, and edtech.

items.title: Vibe coding
items.text: Help shipping the product you are already shaping: structure, pace, and a builder who can sit in the mess with you.

items.title: Grants support
items.text: Analytical, sequential thinking for Finnish and European grant processes — wins on the record, curiosity for yours.

items.title: Network
items.text: Years in corporate roles and seven years in startups have built a broad network across sales, HR, finance, and beyond. Ask me if you need the right person.
